title: Align neutral MCP previews with edited crop and lens geometry
notes: AI-assisted implementation: get_preview accepts originalGeometry=edit with original or side_by_side to retain the edited crop, orientation, transforms, lens geometry and tone mapper while neutralizing other adjustments. Fractional regions therefore inspect the same location on original and edited renders. The default source mode and existing rendering behavior remain unchanged; reads do not modify edits, history or sidecars.
